defects.where: whole cloud layer, centre to edges
defects.what: the cloud deck is a single flat sheet of identical cotton blobs tiled to the horizon, with a straight seam-like gap running from the centre to the vanishing point; it should be broken, varied low cloud and fog banks at different heights, thinning so the islands and sea show through

defects.where: all cloud edges, especially where clouds meet ground
defects.what: cloud edges are a dithered screen-door / halftone stipple (visible checker dots on every border); edges should be smooth soft gradients with no dot pattern

the sky is a flat beige gradient sitting on a hard, perfectly straight pale haze line, and no sea or islands are visible beyond the clouds; the horizon should fade softly with sea and distant land under one grey-blue northern light

defects.where: upper sky, bright cloud rims top left to centre
defects.what: cloud bands are smeared streaks with stripy, stair-stepped bright rims (visible striations near x=150-600, y=150-230); they should be soft volumetric cloud with clean lit edges
around the sun the clouds break into a jagged, aliased hatched pattern; the sun's glow should diffuse smoothly through the overcast
a thin, hard orange-tan line runs straight across the horizon like a seam between sky and sea; the sea should meet the sky in a soft hazy transition
cloud patches show vertical striping/streak artefacts and hard rectangular edges; they should read as soft cloud
the grass is a uniform repeating noise of yellow blotches over olive, like a rug or sponge; close up it should show grass tussocks, bare soil, rocks and scree with varied scale and colour

slopes are smooth, featureless rounded mounds with flat olive-to-ochre shading and no basalt layering, outcrops or cliffs; Faroese valley sides should show stepped dark basalt terraces and rock bands through the grass

defects.where: bay shoreline and cliffs on both sides
defects.what: the coast has no dark basalt sea cliffs, rock or beach; green grass runs straight into the water, and the shoreline foam is a uniform scalloped white band; it should have dark rocky cliffs and a pebble/sand beach with broken surf

the stream is a uniform pale grey ribbon of even width draped over the slope like a road, with blocky white pieces where it meets the lake; it should be a narrow, darker, reflective channel that varies in width and sinks into its bed
streams are thin bright white lines with hard zig-zag kinks that float on the surface and run along the slope rather than down it; they should be subtle darker water lines following the fall line

defects.where: right edge, upper slope near x=1250,y=215
defects.what: a small isolated bright white blob floats on the hillside; nothing should be there, or it should be a properly grounded object

the scene is washed in an even warm golden haze from sky to foreground; sunlit slopes are mustard-ochre rather than Faroese green, and the haze is equally dense at every depth; it should be cool, soft overcast light with green grass and haze that builds with distance
dark blotchy patches on the grass look like smeared stains rather than shadows or ground cover; they should be cloud shadows with soft edges or real rock/heath patches

overall: The terrain shape and general mood are believable, but the clouds are broken across the set (tiled blob layer, dither stipple, striated aliasing around the sun, a hard horizon seam), and the ground reads as smooth noise-textured mounds with no basalt, cliffs or beaches, washed in a warm golden haze rather than cool Faroese light.
